Fork-only commands, APIs and modules named here (`bun mcp`, `bun n2b`, `bun agent-plugin`, `bun wasm`, `bun:windows`, `bun:linux`, `bun:nginx`, ...) are not available on upstream Bun. # Aphrody ecosystem catalog

Every repository, crate, binary, feature, Bun package and uv package of the workspace, extracted
from the checkout. Companion files: [CLI.md](CLI.md) (exact command trees), [MCP-TOOLS.md](MCP-TOOLS.md)
(every MCP tool), [ecosystem.json](ecosystem.json) (machine-readable). Check here before writing new
code: reuse an existing crate, command or tool instead of duplicating it.

Totals: 2 repositories (2 aphrody, 0 shared, 0 experiments), 198 crates, 36 binaries, 47 Bun packages, 10 uv packages, 775 CLI commands, 330 MCP tools.

| Repository | Kind | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [aphrody](#aphrody) | aphrody | Canonical Rust/Bun monorepo |
| [iecode](#iecode) | aphrody | Active game-domain workspace |
